title: Kansas county to pay over $3 million for illegal police raid on local newspaper
summary: A county in rural Kansas has agreed to pay just over $3 million and apologize for a 2023 police raid on a small-town newspaper. The raid sparked an uproar over press freedom.

title: USS Gerald R. Ford heads to Caribbean amid major U.S. military buildup near Venezuela
summary: The world's largest aircraft carrier, the USS Gerald R. Ford, is en route to the Caribbean Sea as U.S. forces expand operations near Venezuela, where recent strikes have killed at least 76 people.
